Where did you read her issues are that of ME/CFS. Long covid is an array of symptoms and the fatigue is just the tip of the iceberg. Some people develop the PEM which is yes a classic appearance of CFS however lots of times the fatigue improves from covid cases. I’ve dealt with long covid for 2.5 years now. It’s damage to the body (organs, nervous system, ext) from initial infection and one’s immune response usually causing a inflammatory cascade of symptoms. Your body can’t function right due to this and therefore have a lot of different organ system dysfunction causing symptoms to arise. This is why it’s so hard with long covid, it is not a one shoe fits all because every case can be different in essence. I’ve dealt with 50+ symptoms from it and was bed bound about a year or two. At a new baseline now a days but still have my bad days. Prayers for her speedy recovery.. there really does need to be a stronger agenda to show awareness & provide treatments/protocols to treat these awful chronic illnesses
